items.title: Hyatt Bahia Principe - Brand positioning, architecture, identity and design system for an all-inclusive resort - Little Black Book | LBBOnline
items.raw_summary: Little Black Book, The architecture work came first, collapsing four sub-brands into two that any traveler—regardless of language or destination—could immediately understand. Because Bahia Principe spans Spain, Mexico, and the Caribbean, we needed names that crossed linguistic borders without losing meaning. Our naming generation landed on Explore, for families and friends, and Escape, for adults-only—each capturing not just who the guest is, but the emotional territory they're seeking: discovery and togetherness on one side, restoration and freedom on the other. The brave idea: Free to Be lives on the horizon—infinite, open, and entirely your own to define. The sun was already theirs. Our job was to give it new meaning. We evolved the existing mark by connecting it to the horizon—the visual metaphor at the core of the brand system—transforming a legacy symbol into something that actively reflects Free to Be. From that anchor point, the entire identity opens up: a refreshed, expansive brand world that feels as limitless as the feeling it was built to express. Color and art direction do the heavy lifting of differentiation. Explore leads with vibrancy and ease—an identity built for the all-in crew, families and friends who want everyone to find their groove without compromise. Escape goes quieter and more sophisticated, designed for guests stepping away from the everyday into an adults-only sanctuary. Consumer research showed 97% would definitely or probably visit a Bahia Principe resort with this identity. Services: Brand Architecture · Positioning · Naming · Visual Identity · Logo Development · Design System · Brand Guidelines
